wildways.guide.title: WildWays Guide
wildways.guide.quest.kill_endermite.desc: Kill an Endermite. Look for them in the Quarantine Grounds or try throwing Ender Pearls.
wildways.guide.quest.shell.description: Collect an Endermite Shell dropped by an Endermite.
wildways.guide.quest.nest.description: Craft an Endermite Nest by surrounding a chest with eight Endermite Shells.
wildways.guide.quest.packed_nest.descrip: Put items inside a placed Endermite Nest, then break it and pick it up with its contents still inside.
wildways.guide.quest.endermite_eye.descr: Leave an Eye of Ender in an Endermite Nest until it turns into an Eye of the Endermite, then collect it.
wildways.guide.quest.bricks.description: Craft Endermite Bricks with an Endermite Shell in the middle and four Stone Bricks around it.
wildways.guide.quest.brew_unease.descrip: Brew an Awkward Potion with an Endermite Shell, then take the Potion of Unease from the brewing stand.
wildways.guide.quest.plant_seed.descript: Plant any crop to start a garden.
Till soil with a diamond or Volcanite hoe. Crops grow faster on soil tilled with better hoes.
wildways.guide.quest.till_netherite_farm: Till soil with a netherite hoe for the fastest crop growth.
wildways.guide.quest.find_cycad.descript: Pick up a cycad that a Sniffer dug up.
wildways.guide.quest.compost_cycad.descr: Fill a composter with cycads, torchflowers or pitcher plants, then collect the compost.
wildways.guide.quest.till_compost.descri: Place a block of compost and till it with a hoe to let crops give a bigger harvest.
wildways.guide.quest.find_sniffer_flower: Pick up a pitcher pod or torchflower seeds that a Sniffer dug up.
Plant a pitcher pod on farmland to keep the soil moist up to three blocks away.
wildways.guide.quest.torchflower_light.d: Place a mature torchflower to light up your garden.
wildways.guide.quest.gold_ripen.descript: Let crops grow next to a mature torchflower or pitcher plant. You might find Gold-Ripened seeds when harvesting.
Try the same thing on compost farmland. Crops grown there are more likely to yield Gold-Ripened seeds.
wildways.guide.quest.eat_gold_ripened_st: Cook a Gold-Ripened potato, then use it with a Gold-Ripened carrot to make and eat rabbit stew.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_fishing_rod.d: Craft a fishing rod from sticks and string.
wildways.guide.quest.hunt_livestock.desc: Slaughter a farm animal for meat.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_magnifying_gl: Craft a magnifying glass from a spyglass and paper to check an animal's weight and living conditions.
wildways.guide.quest.perfect_habitat.des: Give a farm animal grass, light, water and room to move.
wildways.guide.quest.hunt_heavy_livestoc: Raise a farm animal until the magnifying glass shows a weight of 8, then slaughter it.
wildways.guide.quest.bait.description: Craft Beetroot Dough from wheat and beetroot. This bait can produce rich fish.
wildways.guide.quest.rich_fish.descripti: Fish with Beetroot Dough and eat a Rich Fish from your catch.
Craft Candied Bait from a Spider Eye and Sugar. It makes the target easier to catch.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_amethyst_blin: Craft an Amethyst Blinker from an Amethyst Shard and a Copper Ingot to improve your chances of finding treasure.
wildways.guide.quest.load_fishing_bait.d: Combine a fishing rod with any bait in a crafting grid.
wildways.guide.quest.compass.description: Hold a compass to see your coordinates and the direction you are facing.
wildways.guide.quest.biome_compass.descr: Get a Biome Compass from a Wandering Trader.
wildways.guide.quest.locate_biome.descri: Use a Biome Compass and select a biome. Follow the needle to your destination.
wildways.guide.quest.structure_map.descr: Find any map that points to a structure.
wildways.guide.quest.trade_structure_map: Buy a structure map from a Wandering Trader.
wildways.guide.quest.igloo_map.descripti: Look for an Igloo Map in a Snowy Village.
wildways.guide.quest.dungeon_map.descrip: Look for a Monster Room Map in a Mineshaft or an Abandoned Camp.
wildways.guide.quest.mineshaft_map.descr: Look for a Mineshaft Map in a Monster Room or an Abandoned Camp.
wildways.guide.quest.trail_ruins_map.des: Look for a Trail Ruins Map in the Quarantine Grounds.
wildways.guide.quest.pillager_outpost_ma: Get a Pillager Outpost Map from a Pillager Patrol Captain.
wildways.guide.quest.jungle_temple_map.d: Fish in a jungle for a chance to find a Jungle Temple Map.
wildways.guide.quest.desert_temple_map.d: Brush suspicious sand in a desert well to look for a Desert Temple Map.
wildways.guide.quest.swamp_hut_map.descr: Fish in a swamp for a chance to find a Swamp Hut Map.
wildways.guide.quest.ancient_city_map: A Map to the Deep Dark
wildways.guide.quest.ancient_city_map.de: Look for an Ancient City Map in the supply chests of a Trial Chamber.
wildways.guide.quest.land_with_worn_elyt: Keep gliding when your Elytra reaches its last point of durability, then land safely.
wildways.guide.quest.read_light_sensor.d: Hold a Light Sensor to display the local light level.
wildways.guide.quest.read_clock.descript: Hold a clock to read the time on its dial and the current day.
wildways.guide.quest.mine_with_copper.de: Break a block with a copper tool to see how quickly it mines.
wildways.guide.quest.refine_iron.descrip: Use a Gold, Amethyst or Quartz Refinement to upgrade an iron tool, weapon or armor piece at a Smithing Table.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_gold_refineme: Craft a Gold Refinement with four gold ingots around an iron ingot.
wildways.guide.quest.refine_gold.descrip: Use a Gold Refinement at a Smithing Table to upgrade a piece of iron equipment to gold.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_amethyst_refi: Craft an Amethyst Refinement with four amethyst shards around an iron ingot.
wildways.guide.quest.amethyst_combat.des: Land a hit with an amethyst tool or weapon. Amethyst lets you attack faster.
wildways.guide.quest.wear_amethyst_armor: Equip all four pieces of amethyst armor to increase your agility.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_quartz_refine: Craft a Quartz Refinement with four quartz around an iron ingot.
wildways.guide.quest.quartz_tool.descrip: Refine any iron tool or weapon at a Smithing Table to improve its durability.
wildways.guide.quest.wear_quartz_armor.d: Equip all four pieces of quartz armor.
Find and collect Raw Volcanite in a Basalt Delta.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_volcanite_ref: Smelt Raw Volcanite, then craft a Volcanite Refinement with four Volcanite Ingots around an emerald.
wildways.guide.quest.volcanite_tool.desc: Obtain any Volcanite tool or weapon by refining quartz, amethyst or gold equipment at a Smithing Table. Volcanite extends your reach.
wildways.guide.quest.wear_volcanite_armo: Equip all four pieces of Volcanite armor to place blocks from farther away.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_diamond_refin: Craft a Diamond Refinement with four diamonds around an emerald.
wildways.guide.quest.refine_diamond.desc: Upgrade a quartz, amethyst or gold tool, weapon or armor piece with a Diamond Refinement at a Smithing Table.
wildways.guide.quest.fletch_arrows.descr: Make any arrow at a Fletching Table.
wildways.guide.quest.fletch_turtle_arrow: Combine ordinary arrows with a turtle scute at a Fletching Table to make Turtle Arrows.
Combine ordinary arrows with a phantom membrane at a Fletching Table to make Range Arrows.
wildways.guide.quest.fletch_explosive_ar: Combine ordinary arrows with TNT at a Fletching Table to make Explosive Arrows.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_rune.descript: Craft a rune of any tier. Runes determine the enchantment level you can apply at an Enchanting Table.
wildways.guide.quest.rune_enchanting.des: Enchant a piece of equipment at an Enchanting Table using lapis, a rune and an Enchanted Book.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_enchanting_ca: Craft an Enchanting Catalyst with a Sculk Catalyst, chiseled stone bricks, lapis blocks and blaze powder.
wildways.guide.quest.use_enchanting_cata: Use an Enchanting Catalyst at the enchanting table to save levels.
wildways.guide.quest.mending.description: Obtain a piece of equipment enchanted with Mending.
wildways.guide.quest.repair_mending_item: Repair a damaged item enchanted with Mending in an anvil with one matching repair material.
wildways.guide.quest.stack_potions.descr: Stack eight identical Potions in a single inventory slot.
wildways.guide.quest.brew_level_two.desc: Brew a stronger Potion with Glowstone Dust.
wildways.guide.quest.brew_supreme.descri: Add Popped Chorus Fruit to the strongest version of a Potion with a positive effect to get a Supreme Potion.
wildways.guide.quest.drink_supreme.descr: Drink any Supreme Potion. Try its effect and see what side effect comes with it.
wildways.guide.quest.brew_fatal.descript: Add Popped Chorus Fruit to the strongest version of a Potion with a negative effect to get a Fatal Potion.
wildways.guide.quest.use_fatal.descripti: Use a Fatal Splash or Lingering Potion on a mob.
wildways.guide.quest.tip_eight_arrows.de: Put eight ordinary arrows in the middle slot and a potion on the right to get Tipped Arrows.
wildways.guide.quest.tip_stack_arrows.de: Use a lingering potion in a Fletching Table to make 64 arrows at once.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_ice.descript: Look for an Eye of Ice in the chests of Snowy Villages or Igloos.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_water.descri: Drop an Eye of Ender in water or rain within range of an active Conduit and collect the Eye of Water.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_sulfur.descr: Drop an Eye of Ender into the water directly above Potent Sulfur and collect the Eye of Sulfur.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_the_tiger.de: Find the Eye of the Tiger in either chest of a jungle temple. Watch out for traps.
wildways.guide.quest.lost_eye.descriptio: Brush suspicious gravel in Trail Ruins or search the hidden Endermite Bunker in the Quarantine Grounds for a Lost Eye.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_storm.descri: Place an Eye of Ender in the center of a crafting table, Breeze Rods in the corners, and Wind Charges on the four sides.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_the_brute.de: Defeat Piglin Brutes in a bastion and collect an Eye of the Brute from them.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_the_creaking: Strike Creakings in a Pale Garden and look for the eye they can drop.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_brewing.desc: Brew an Eye of Brewing by sequentially using a nether wart, then a phantom membrane and finally a ghast tear on an Eye of Ender in the Brewing Stand.
wildways.guide.quest.enchanted_eye.descr: Craft the eye with an Eye of Ender in the center, Amethyst Shards in the corners and Lapis on the sides. At an Enchanting Table, use an Attunement book to enchant it.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_volcanite.de: Craft an Eye of Volcanite with an Eye of Ender and four Volcanite Ingots in a cross. Drop the eye in fire to prepare it for the End portal.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_illagers.des: Drop an Eye of Ender near an Evoker and wait for him to cast his spell.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_darkness.des: Craft an Eye of Darkness with an Eye of Ender and four Echo Shards.
wildways.guide.quest.collect_portal_eyes: Carry twelve different WildWays eyes at the same time.
wildways.guide.quest.activate_end_portal: Open an End portal by placing twelve different portal-ready eyes into its frames.
wildways.guide.quest.find_wither_skull.d: Hunt wither skeletons in a Nether fortress for a skull.
wildways.guide.quest.find_sculk_wither_s: Look for a Sculk-Covered Wither Skull in an Ancient City.
wildways.guide.quest.find_gold_wither_sk: Search a Bastion Remnant for a Gold-Adorned Wither Skull.
wildways.guide.quest.summon_wither.descr: Summon the Wither using either three regular Wither Skeleton Skulls or one skull of each type.
wildways.guide.quest.defeat_wither.descr: Defeat a Wither. Be aware of its stronger capabilities.
